answer: An adversary therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The basalt schedule is applied in timber and quill shows each instalment. A payout is split which means 44% arrives at settlement and the rest over 8 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 4360 identities would post 4460 proofs and burn roughly 46 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
